result:
The override image and its README are committed, and PR #331 is marked ready. Nothing reads the new folder yet, so scores won't change until lane.toolsmith's scorer change (defect 17) lands.

- **Hash checked:** I copied console set K's `Texture_format::TexFmt_R6G5B5.png` byte for byte to `docs/testing/golden_overrides/Texture_format/TexFmt_R6G5B5.png`. Its sha256 is `07dedad9…385f8`, the value the brief required. The calib run is under `/home/justin/hakux-work/hardware/`, not `hakuX/hardware`, so `find_captures.py` misses it unless you pass that path.
- **README:** `docs/testing/golden_overrides/README.md` has one row: suite, test, source capture, the sha256 of both the override and the upstream golden, the `C: 0` vs `C: 1` reason, and #287. It says the folder is unused until the defect 17 hook lands, and that overrides are keyed on suite/test because `Texture_render_target` has its own `TexFmt_R6G5B5`.
- **The old falsifier doesn't run on master.** goldencorr287's `falsify.sh` needs a patched scorer and override that were never committed. I wrote `docs/lanes/goldovr287/falsify.sh` to replace it. It builds the override-aware scorer from master's `score_sweep.py` each time it runs, points it at the committed folder, and fails if the line it patches has moved.
- **Falsifier result:** re-scoring run `z-c866527e03` gives the same numbers as #300:

  | Sweep | Without override | With override | Rows that changed |
  |---|---:|---:|---|
  | Texture_format | 134,902 px | 0 px | only `TexFmt_R6G5B5` (white-content → ok) |
  | Texture_format, repeat run | 134,902 px | 0 px | the same row only |
  | Texture_render_target | 1,473 px | 1,473 px | none; its own `TexFmt_R6G5B5` stays at 0 |

Preflight passes, and the PR's `Files:` line matches the diff (four files, all inside the granted paths). There is no prediction or device run, since the captures themselves don't change. The results are in `docs/lanes/goldovr287/NOTES.md`, and I posted `[lane.goldovr287]` comments on the PR and on #287.
